regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: The actual article title and aggregate 22-example method claim were inspected. The page states Supporting Information availability, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
Concentricolide, porphyrylic acid, furanclausamines, and claulansine D are motivation/examples, not reaction experiments in this article.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1a and 1b under Previous works
regions.finding: HDDA/electrophile capture and metal-catalyzed [2+2+2] cyclization are cited prior-work reaction classes and were classified as literature examples, not current experiments.
The Pd(OAc)2/TFP/Na2CO3/H2O/CH3CN alkyne annulation is explicitly the group's cited recent work and is retained as a literature example with its displayed conditions and >99/1 regioselectivity.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1d This work and initial-experiment prose
regions.finding: The generic PPh3/Cs2CO3/DMA transformation is a general scheme. The initial 1a/2a experiment continues on page 2 as Table 1 entry 1 and is represented once with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: Scheme 1 generic R/Z/Y groups do not define unique structures or full procedures.
The initial experiment's exact masses, workup, purification, and isolated masses are not reported.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left narrative and Table 1 entries 1–11 with footnotes
regions.finding: Eleven independent optimization runs were retained with row base, solvent, temperature, time, separate crude-NMR 3aa/4aa yields, 1.0 mmol override for entry 1, and all shared Pd/TFP/base/H2O/solvent/N2 conditions.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 entries 1–10, ligand drawings, and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten independent ligand/temperature runs were retained with separate 3aa/4aa crude-NMR yields and recovery of 1a. The prose reports 77% at 70 °C while entry 8 reports 78%; both values remain in that row with an unresolved conflict.

The prose maps the ordinary Scheme 2 rows, a separate gram-scale 1a/2e repeat (3ae 70%, 4ae 8%), X-ray characterization of 3eh, and the 3jh two-product outcome to page 3 rather than creating duplicate narrative records.
A distinct 0.5 mmol 1k/2a experiment under Pd(OAc)2/PPh3/Cs2CO3/H2O/DMA/N2 at 70 °C for 12 h gives 3ka in 34%.
The carbon- and nitrogen-tethered experiments are linked to the two explicit arrows on page 3; no prose-only duplicate was created.

unresolved: Optimization rows omit masses, workups, purifications, and isolated masses.
Table 2 entry 8 has a 77% narrative versus 78% table yield conflict.
The gram-scale 3ae repeat does not print exact substrate amount or solvent volume.

regions.region: page 3 left upper Scheme 2 header, sixteen ordinary products, and footnotes
regions.finding: Sixteen distinct carbonate/alcohol scope experiments were retained with shared 1.0 mmol/1.2 equiv/Pd(OAc)2/PPh3/Cs2CO3/H2O/DMA/N2/70 °C conditions, row times/yields, 2.1-equiv H2O overrides, and product-specific isolated beta-H-elimination byproduct yields in parentheses.
The 1.07 g/70% 3ae plus 8% 4ae/14 h gram-scale repeat is a separate experiment from the 1 mmol/12 h 3ae row and was not merged by product label.
The ORTEP is characterization of the existing 1e/2h→3eh scope experiment, not another synthesis and not machine-structure verification.
Two distinct tether-scope experiments were retained: carbon-tethered 1l/2a→3la (49%, 11.3 h) and N-tosyl nitrogen-tethered 1m/2i→3mi (55%, 13 h, 2.1 equiv H2O).
Two optically active substrate experiments were retained separately with starting and product ee values: (R)-1n/2i→(R)-3ni and (R)-1o/2a→(R)-3oa.
A distinct symmetric 1p double-annulation uses doubled loadings and gives six-ring product 3pa in 43% after 70 °C/12.5 h.
IN-1 through IN-4 and the competing nucleophilic-attack/beta-H-elimination paths are a proposed mechanism, not isolated preparations.

unresolved: Scope rows omit masses, workups, purifications, and most isolated masses.
The exact gram-scale substrate charge and whether the 3ae 2.1-equiv H2O exception carries to the repeat are not printed.
Complex product and intermediate structures remain label-only and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Scheme 5 discussion and conclusions
regions.finding: The text completes the proposed IN-4 branching rationale and summarizes the reaction class; it adds no independent experiment or yield.

regions.region: page 4 Associated Content and Accession Codes

Bibliography and prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.

unresolved: SI association remains unestablished despite the article's availability statement.
CCDC 1870594 is crystallographic data, not an explicitly associated workspace SI file.
The reproduction acknowledgment does not define separable runs.
